findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.3:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 11 different lines (112px, 144px, 442px, 752px, 1057px, 132px, 194px); the three most used hold only 55% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Little motion: 14 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.

findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 4 lines at 390px: "“There’s a difference between selling pr…" → 5 lines at 24px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.
